Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "What's the weather?", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4", "tools" => [["function" => ["name" => "get_weather", "parameters" => ["properties" => ["city" => ["type" => "string"]], "type" => "object"]], "type" => "function"]]]));
$chunks = iterator_to_array(LiterLlm::chatStream($req));
```
